checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Frames sampled across 0.6–5.7 s of 6 s show a wide frame, about 1.67:1 like the source picture (roughly 16:9).

must.item: Stripes, rocky coast and composition match the first-turn picture
must.why: The lighthouse, rocks, headland and sky layout all match the source image.

must.item: Watercolor look and dusk lighting remain throughout
must.why: Paper texture, washes and the purple/orange dusk sky are stable in every frame.

must.item: Waves visibly move against the rocks and a beam sweeps across the water
must.why: The foam around the rocks changes between frames, so the waves move. No beam is visible in any frame and the lantern shows no light, so the beam sweep is missing.

must.item: No added writing or audible sound
must.why: No text appears in any frame. The video was described as silent and audio can't be heard from frames.

faults.what: No lighthouse beam is visible in any sampled frame, and the lantern does not glow. This is a requested key element.
Wave motion is subtle, and the sea and foam only change a little between frames.
The sky and lighthouse look almost static, so the clip reads like a near-still image.

summary: The video stays faithful to the watercolor lighthouse picture and the waves move gently, but the requested sweeping lighthouse beam is not visible in any frame.
